races.paceDynamic: Strange Currency is the only confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop over this extended trip on yielding ground. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Mr Babes, Oaks Soldier, Belladona Princess, Walk Away Harry, Friends Of Barry, Fenian Maxios, Three County Star), the pace will be moderate early before building from halfway. Jackmoon and Nopresentliketime can track Strange Currency in the prominent positions behind the leader. This honest pace and extended distance clearly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, particularly those with stamina proven over similar trips.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Strange Currency sets a steady pace without pressure from 2 out
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks, with proven stayers like Oaks Soldier and Belladona Princess timing their runs perfectly. Multiple hold-up horses swamp the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Jackmoon and Nopresentliketime press Strange Currency from the home turn
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents hold-up horses from closing effectively on the soft ground. Prominent runners with tactical speed can kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Strange Currency gets completely uncontested fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and save energy for a final surge when challenged. Form from Punchestown suggests Strange Currency has the class when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomers Brightmarchmorning or Tom Mac show hidden ability
scenarios.body: Either unexposed runner could have significant improvement in them given their limited exposure and breeding profiles. The moderate pace setup would perfectly suit a well-bred newcomer stepping forward dramatically.

races.paceDynamic: Whiskey Serenade is the sole confirmed front-runner in this large field and will dictate terms from the outset with no obvious early pressure. The lack of other keen leaders means she can control the fractions and save energy for a sustained kick, while prominent racers like Mollys Dolly, Bowgate Street and Single Edition will track within striking distance. A large contingent of hold-up horses including Toon Town, The Sugarhill Lady, Tea It Is and Only For Our Man will be looking to come from off the pace in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early, as the uncontested leader will have every tactical advantage over the crowded pack of hold-up horses fighting for racing room late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Whiskey Serenade gets uncontested fractions and maintains her gallop
scenarios.body: She controls the race from pillar to post with the large field struggling to organize a challenge from behind. The prominent racers get first run at her but lack the tactical advantage to reel her in.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers can get competitive fractions from Whiskey Serenade in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The pace-pressers get first run and have enough left to capitalize when the leader's stamina wanes. Hold-up horses find too much traffic and ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If Whiskey Serenade goes too fast early or the race develops into a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays into the hands of the patient hold-up horses who can produce their best finishing kicks. The early leaders pay for their exertions in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Whiskey Serenade stops quickly and the prominent racers fail to capitalize on good positions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse with a finishing kick can prevail regardless of early position. Fresh horses returning from breaks or those with untapped ability can emerge.

Cork's yielding ground conditions favor horses with proven form on similar surfaces
Multiple horses trying tongue-ties for first time including Party Pack, Brave Endeavour and Houndsworth

races.paceDynamic: Sky Lord is the only confirmed front runner in this 9-runner field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a manageable tempo over this 2m1f trip. The prominent racers Champagne Mahler, The Busy Fool, Prince Of Air, and River Vale will track behind but none are aggressive early pace forcers. This creates a race where the tempo builds gradually rather than being fierce from the start, with the real pressure coming from the back straight onwards as the hold-up horses Path d'Oroux, Sportinthepark, In The Trenches, and Glenashling look to make their moves. This sustainable early pace clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sky Lord Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Sky Lord gets an easy lead and maintains his jumping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: His uncontested advantage allows him to dictate terms and he has enough left to resist late challenges on ground that suits. The lack of early pace pressure plays directly into his hands as a natural front runner returning from a break.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers tracks Sky Lord perfectly and times their challenge to perfection
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows horses like The Busy Fool or Prince Of Air to travel comfortably in behind before producing a decisive move in the final half mile. Their tactical positioning proves superior to both the lone leader and the held-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and creates a sprint finish from the back straight
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows Path d'Oroux or Sportinthepark to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. However, they need the race to become a real test of stamina rather than tactical speed over this shorter distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Sky Lord goes too slow early and gets swamped by everything in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This chaotic finish could suit an improver like River Vale who has been in good form recently.

Prince Of Air is 2lb wrong at the weights from his Killarney win but the ground may be against him today

races.paceDynamic: Lucy Wang will set the early pace with The Great Unknown and Rebel Treaty tracking prominently, creating a measured gallop over this extended trip on yielding ground. The uncontested leader Lucy Wang may dictate terms through the middle stages, but her tendency to fade late could open the door. With limited early pace pressure and stamina demands mounting, this setup strongly favours prominent racers who can position close enough to strike when the pace-setter weakens. The race shape clearly benefits horses with tactical pace who can travel well and produce their best effort in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Unbeaten Streak Continues
scenarios.trigger: If The Great Unknown settles well tracking Lucy Wang and produces her customary late kick.
scenarios.body: Her perfect record in points and proven ability on similar ground makes her the logical beneficiary when Lucy Wang fades late. The measured early pace will suit her prominent style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lucy Wang's class from winning the Gain Mares Final overcomes her finishing concerns and the pace stays modest throughout.
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead on yielding ground could negate her stamina doubts if she can dictate a slow enough gallop. Her recent Ballynoe success suggests she has the ability when conditions align.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Sworn Duty's point-to-point experience translates immediately to this sphere with the benefit of her half-sister connections to proven winners.
scenarios.body: Her breeding suggests she could improve significantly for this step up in class, and lightly raced horses often surprise in these maiden events. The lack of early pace pressure would suit a newcomer finding her rhythm.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Lucy Wang early, creating a stronger gallop than expected and setting up a dramatic finish.
scenarios.body: The increased pace would compromise Lucy Wang's stamina while potentially bringing hold-up horses like Tiffiny's Girl into contention late. This scenario would create the most unpredictable finish with several possible winners.

watchPoints.text: Lucy Wang's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when challenged could end her chance given her finishing concerns

Sworn Duty's adaptation to the bigger obstacles - her point form suggests ability but this represents a significant step up in grade

races.paceDynamic: Pirate Island is the only confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field, meaning he can dictate proceedings without pressure and set a sustainable gallop over this staying trip on yielding ground. The prominent racers Sampoet, Hunt Away, Focus Point and Occupational Force will track him through the early stages, but none are natural pace forcers. This creates a race that builds gradually, with the real action coming from the back straight home as the hold-up horses Hearts And Spades, Dromleigh, Our Story and Nibbles make their moves. The tactical verdict clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll benefit from the modest early gallop and have the class edge in this maiden hunter chase field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Pirate Island sets an uncontested steady pace through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from two out, perfectly suiting the classy hold-up performers who have been conserving energy. Hearts And Spades and Dromleigh can unleash their superior finishing kicks to settle their Dromahane rematch.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trackers increase the tempo from halfway to put pressure on the leaders
scenarios.body: Sampoet and Focus Point benefit from their forward positions while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing ground. Their class ratings and recent form give them the edge over the pace-setter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pirate Island stays clear
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can match Pirate Island's jumping and stamina over this extended trip
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead becomes unassailable as others make mistakes or tire on the demanding ground. The 14-race hurdles maiden finally finds his optimum conditions in hunter chasing.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider benefits from pace
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get involved in a speed battle or make crucial jumping errors
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced improver like Lawful Ruler or recent point winner Atlantian can sneak through as the market leaders compromise each other. Their fresh legs and lower expectations prove decisive.

The market moves on Sampoet and Hunt Away, as both have question marks but represent yards that know when their horses are ready

races.paceDynamic: Journey With Me is the sole confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field, likely to set an uncontested lead alongside prominent racers Solitary Man, Bartlemy Boy, and Asian Master tracking close behind. With no genuine pace pressure early, the tempo will be moderate through the first circuit, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses including In Excelsis Deo, Jetoile, and Temptationinmilan to stay within striking distance. The lack of early pace and Cork's flat, galloping track configuration strongly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can produce sustained finishing kicks over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Journey With Me sets predictable fractions without genuine pressure and the field stays bunched turning for home.
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows hold-up specialists to conserve energy and unleash late runs. Cork's flat finish suits horses with tactical speed who can quicken decisively in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Solitary Man, Asian Master and Bartlemy Boy press Journey With Me earlier than expected, creating genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and exposes hold-up horses who struggle to close the gap. Those racing prominently throughout maintain their positions as others fail to respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Journey With Me Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays slow throughout and no horse can mount a serious challenge to the leader's advantage.
scenarios.body: The front runner's uncontested lead becomes insurmountable as the field leaves their runs too late. Journey With Me's stamina reserves prove decisive when others struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Journey With Me stops quickly or makes jumping errors, leaving no clear pace angle through the race.
scenarios.body: The tactical race becomes a sprint finish with multiple horses converging simultaneously. The winner emerges from those best positioned in the final quarter-mile regardless of early tactics.
